desks.name: Design Manager
desks.owns: intake, staffing, the loop, the dashboard, the handback
desks.description: The front desk. Runs in the main session through the studio skill.

desks.name: Creative Director
desks.owns: direction and sign-off against the rubric
desks.description: Sets the direction for a job and signs off finished visual work by scoring the rendered screenshots against the studio rubric. Use for direction and sign-off only, never to build.

desks.name: Art Director
desks.owns: the pick, the notes, the pen on escalation
desks.description: Picks one of three rendered roughs and writes exact, numbered notes a builder applies; takes the pen for one round when a desk is stuck. Use for the pick, the notes and escalation only.

desks.name: Brand Strategist
desks.owns: positioning, the claim, voice, architecture, brand audits
desks.description: Decides what a brand stands for: positioning, the one claim, voice and tone, architecture, and audits an existing brand against it. Use before a brand kit, a launch or any job where the claim is not yet settled.

desks.name: Typographer
desks.owns: pairing, scale, measure, leading, weights, optical details
desks.description: Sets the type system for a job: pairing, scale, measure, leading, weights, tracking, numerals, and fixes type on a round when a note is about type. Use for type decisions, not layout.

desks.name: Design System Lead
desks.owns: tokens, DESIGN.md, exports, consistency audits
desks.description: Turns a brand into tokens by job, keeps .desk/DESIGN.md exact, exports CSS variables, Tailwind or DTCG, and audits files for values off the system. Use for tokens, extraction and consistency.

desks.name: Accessibility Specialist
desks.owns: WCAG 2.2 AA beyond the automated checks, with code fixes
desks.description: Audits structure, names, keyboard, focus, motion, colour meaning and text against WCAG 2.2 AA and writes the code fix for every finding. Use for accessibility audits and fixes, after proof has run.

desks.name: Copy Editor
desks.owns: correctness, consistency, clarity, the last read
desks.description: The last read before words ship: spelling, grammar, consistency of terms and numbers, clarity, facts marked unverified, the voice kept. Use on any copy before sign-off.

desks.name: UX Researcher
desks.owns: audience, jobs, pains, evidence, research questions and plans
desks.description: Finds what is true before the studio decides: the audience, their job and pains with evidence, what is observed versus inferred, and the cheapest research to close gaps. Use at the start of standard and full jobs.

desks.name: Product Designer
desks.owns: scope, the core flow, trade-offs, first version versus later
desks.description: Decides what the thing should be: outcome, the shortest flow, scope in and out, states, trade-offs, one success measure. Use before UX and UI on any product or page with a flow.

desks.name: UX Designer
desks.owns: flows, wireframes, information architecture, interaction rules, edge cases
desks.description: Designs the flow and the structure: screens, navigation, names, edge cases, as grey wireframes with real copy and real hierarchy. Use before visual design on pages, apps and multi-step flows.

desks.name: Interaction Designer
desks.owns: states, gestures, transitions, feedback, clickable prototypes
desks.description: Designs how things respond: every state of every control, gestures with fallbacks, transitions, feedback timing, keyboard paths, as a clickable HTML prototype. Use for components and flows with interaction.

desks.name: Presentation Designer
desks.owns: slide systems and decks at 1920x1080
desks.description: Designs decks that work in a room: a slide system, takeaway headlines, one idea per slide, type for the back row, as one HTML file with a slide per element. Use for pitch, product, internal and talk decks.

desks.name: Dashboard Architect
desks.owns: dashboard information architecture, layout, density, states
desks.description: Designs screens people decide from daily: the decisions and their metrics, KPI row, chart areas, filters, tables, states, at phone, tablet and desktop. Use for dashboards and admin screens.

desks.name: Landing Page Designer
desks.owns: above the fold, section order, pricing, conversion details
desks.description: Designs the page with one job: the hero that passes the five-second test, the sections that each prove something, pricing and sign-up, on a phone and a desktop. Use for landing, pricing and sign-up pages.

desks.name: Social Media Strategist
desks.owns: the plan, the calendar, launch sequences, platform rules, measurement
desks.description: Decides what gets posted where, when and why: goal, pillars, cadence the user can keep, a calendar with formats and assets, launch day order, one number per platform. Use before social content and campaigns.

desks.name: Growth/Analytics Specialist
desks.owns: the metric, tracking plans, variant plans, honest reads, reports
desks.description: Defines one metric per goal with a baseline, designs tracking and variant plans without personal data, and reads results honestly, saying too early when it is. Use for measurement, A/B plans and performance reports.

desks.name: Compliance Designer
desks.owns: consent, privacy, email footers, accessibility obligations, regulated flows
desks.description: Makes regulated flows correct and humane: consent with equal choices, plain-language notices, data rights, email footers, payment and health disclosures, no dark patterns, with sources and lawyer flags. Use when a job touches data, consent, email or a regulated sector.

desks.name: Conversational Designer
desks.owns: dialogue, chat and voice flows, message types, guardrails
desks.description: Designs what a product says when it talks: the opening, short turns, every branch with an exit, confirmations, errors, voice prompts for the ear, as a clickable prototype. Use for chat interfaces, assistants and voice.

desks.name: Spatial Designer
desks.owns: headset and AR layout in metres and degrees, comfort, input fallbacks
desks.description: Designs for headsets and AR: distances, angles, type and targets in degrees, depth hierarchy, anchoring, comfort rules, input fallbacks, as a WebXR prototype or an annotated layout plus a native spec. Use for spatial and AR work.

desks.name: AI Prompt Engineer
desks.owns: prompt packs, cross-tool variants, critiques, consistency strategies
desks.description: Writes and fixes prompts for image, video and audio generators the user has: six elements in order, short exclusions, parameters, two variations, a cross-tool variant, seed and reference strategy, rights lines. Use for any generated media and prompt critiques.

desks.name: UI Designer
desks.owns: layout, type, colour and composition in one self-contained file
desks.description: Builds one self-contained HTML or SVG file to a brief, a brand and a standard, as a rough in a named composition pattern or as a polish round applying numbered notes. Use for making the file only.

desks.name: Social Media Designer
desks.owns: cards, stories, carousels, thumbnails, series consistency
desks.description: Makes feed visuals that read at thumbnail size: cards at platform sizes from one DOM, stories, ten-slide carousels in one file, thumbnails, with a series that looks like one series. Use for social assets.

desks.name: Social Media Copywriter
desks.owns: on-card copy, captions per platform, carousel copy, alt text
desks.description: Writes the headline on the card and the caption under it, per platform, with the hook in the first line, carousel copy slide by slide, alt text, no openers and no hype. Use for social copy.

desks.name: Email Designer
desks.owns: 600px table email that renders everywhere, dark mode, the bulletproof CTA
desks.description: Builds HTML email that renders in real clients: 600px tables, inline styles, metric fallbacks, dark mode, one bulletproof button, plain-text part, preheader, under 102KB. Use for email templates.

desks.name: Email Copywriter
desks.owns: subject, preheader, body with one ask, sequences, transactional copy
desks.description: Writes the email: a subject under 50 characters, a preheader that continues it, a body with one idea and one verb-first CTA, sequences with a job per email, plain text. Use for email copy and campaigns.

desks.name: Motion Designer
desks.owns: motion systems, micro-interactions, transitions, deterministic clips
desks.description: Makes things move with intent: duration and easing scales, micro-interactions on transform and opacity, reduced motion, and 6 to 10 second clips as deterministic CSS timelines the recorder captures. Use for UI motion and clips.

desks.name: Illustration Director
desks.owns: illustration style, spots, hero art, diagrams, systems
desks.description: Decides when a picture earns its place and makes it: a style written as numbers, spots, hero art, diagrams with real text labels, as SVG in the brand palette. Use for illustration and diagrams.

desks.name: Icon Designer
desks.owns: icon grid, stroke, optical corrections, the set, the SVG contract
desks.description: Draws icons that read at 16px on one grid with one stroke weight, one metaphor per meaning, optically corrected, as currentColor SVGs with a sprite and a contact sheet. Use for icon sets.

desks.name: Image Editor
desks.owns: selection, crops and focal points, treatment, scrims, exports
desks.description: Makes photographs and renders work in a design: rights checked, focal points per size, one grade for the set, measured scrims under text, exports within budget with alt text. Use when a design carries images.

desks.name: Data Viz Designer
desks.owns: chart choice, honest axes, direct labels, colourblind palettes, inline SVG
desks.description: Turns a question and data into a chart that answers it in two seconds: the right type, a takeaway title, bars from zero, direct labels, colourblind-safe brand palettes, as HTML with inline SVG. Use for charts and data visuals.

desks.name: Design Engineer
desks.owns: production HTML and CSS, components in the project's framework, states, performance
desks.description: Turns a signed-off design into production code in the project's own conventions: semantic HTML, tokens not values, every state, zero layout shift, a performance budget. Use when a design ships into a codebase.

desks.name: Framework Specialist
desks.owns: idiomatic components in React, Vue, Svelte, Next.js or Astro
desks.description: Converts finished HTML and CSS into an idiomatic, typed component in the project's framework and styling approach, states and accessibility intact, with an example usage. Use for framework conversion.

desks.name: Editorial Designer
desks.owns: grids, page systems, long-form hierarchy, figures, print PDFs
desks.description: Lays out long things: reports, docs, one-pagers, case studies, with a grid, a baseline, four levels of hierarchy, figures after their references, a true contents, and a PDF when it prints. Use for anything longer than a screen.

desks.name: Print Designer
desks.owns: trim, bleed, safe area, ink, resolution, the print PDF and preflight
desks.description: Designs for paper: business cards, posters, brochures, with bleed, safe area, type in points, ink rules, images at resolution, a PDF at trim plus bleed and a preflight list. Use for anything that leaves a printer.

desks.name: Storyboard Artist
desks.owns: beat sheets, frames as HTML, eye path, caption timing, the hook frame
desks.description: Turns a script into timed beats and real HTML frames at the clip size, with a hook frame that works as a still, one change per beat, captions timed to reading time, 9:16 boarded separately. Use between script and motion.

desks.name: Video Editor
desks.owns: pacing, captions, platform specs, loops, QC, exports
desks.description: Cuts and finishes: trims beats, times and places captions, meets each platform's spec, makes site loops seamless, runs the QC list, exports with a poster. Use on every clip before it ships.

desks.name: Video/Content Producer
desks.owns: scripts with timings, series plans, the hook, the ask
desks.description: Writes the script and the plan: one thing per clip, the hook in the first second, timed lines, captions under ten words, speakable voiceover, one ask, series with a cadence, rewritten per platform. Use first on any video job.

desks.name: Content Designer
desks.owns: headlines, sublines, buttons, labels, empty states, errors
desks.description: Writes the words on the thing: headlines that claim, sublines that prove, verb-first buttons, labels, empty states and errors that say what to do, within the lengths the layout allows, in the brand voice. Use for interface and asset copy.

desks.name: AI Image Director
desks.owns: shot lists, direction, candidate selection, moodboards, fit
desks.description: Directs generated imagery like a photographer: whether it should exist, the shot list, light, lens, composition with room for copy, judges candidates, three moodboard directions, disclosure. Use for generated images and moodboards.

desks.name: AI Video Director
desks.owns: shot-by-shot direction, tool choice per shot, consistency, selection
desks.description: Directs generated video shot by shot: which shots are generated, recorded or rendered, one move per shot, durations the tool honours, consistency by reference frame, judges clips, disclosure. Use for generated video.

desks.name: AI Audio & Voice Producer
desks.owns: voiceover briefs, stings, UI sounds, music beds, loudness, rights
desks.description: Produces the sound a piece needs, when it needs one: voice described plainly with a script marked for the ear, stings in the motion language, beds that duck, loudness targets, consent and disclosure, a silent fallback. Use for voice and audio.
